entries.title: See what a task is waiting for
entries.body: Kanban tiles group a task’s waits beside its next recorded event. Hover previews and task cards show every wait and its own time, including unknown times, without adding more to task lists. A read, check-back, reset or start time is not a finish estimate.

picture.alt: A task card shows SCR-1 with an unknown end time, its recorded wait time and a separate start time.
